title: How to turn forecourt advertising into in-store sales with unified commerce
summary: Turn gas station pump ads into in-store sales by connecting your forecourt, loyalty app and POS on one unified commerce platform. Here's how.
body_markdown:
To turn gas station pump advertising into actual in-store sales, you need to connect your forecourt displays, mobile loyalty app and point-of-sale on a single unified commerce platform. Pump ads alone generate impressions, not purchases. When your forecourt, loyalty data and in-store transactions share a single data layer, you can trigger personalized offers at the pump, track redemption in real time and convert a several-minute fuel stop into a higher-margin store visit.


#### Key takeaways


- Forecourt advertising is a commerce moment, not a media channel. Treat it as a conversion trigger connected to your loyalty and POS systems, not a standalone awareness play.
- Fragmented systems create data silos. Separate pump displays, mobile apps, loyalty platforms and in-store POS cannot share what they know. That blocks real-time personalization, and it makes forecourt-to-store conversion impossible to measure.
- Unified commerce connects fuel, retail and dining on one platform with a shared data layer, enabling your team to activate personalized offers at the pump and track them through to in-store purchase.
- Platforms, not point solutions, drive the next phase of growth; adding more marketing tools without orchestration increases operational complexity without improving conversion rates.


#### The forecourt is high-value and systemically underleveraged


The forecourt is one of the last disconnected moments in an otherwise digital-first commerce journey, and that's where the biggest growth opportunity still exists. By NCR Voyix's own estimates, roughly 70 percent of fuel customers buy only fuel in a typical stop and never come inside the store. That is a large, high-intent audience arriving at your sites every day that most retailers never convert into a store visit.


When your shoppers pull into a gas station to fill up, they are on-site for several minutes. A[2024 Geotab analysis](https://www.geotab.com/blog/fleet-refueling/) of 14 million trips across more than 150,000 vehicles found that fleet drivers spend about eight minutes at the gas station on a typical fuel stop (Geotab, 2024). That is a meaningful window of captive attention that retailers can use to build brand presence and prompt a next action.


#### The forecourt is a commerce moment, not a media channel


Many CMOs understand the benefit of[forecourt marketing](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/resources/blog/how-to-boost-gas-station-visits-and-revenue-with-forecourt-advertising) . But they don't realize that simply adding signage promoting coffee isn't enough. They treat it as a top-of-funnel awareness channel and track impressions. But impressions don't mean outcomes.


> The mistake is optimizing for the wrong thing. Retailers should stop measuring digital versus physical, or impressions versus reach, and start optimizing for the outcome they actually want, which is a sale. When you treat the forecourt as a commerce moment instead of a media channel, every interaction at the pump becomes a chance to convert, not just to be seen. — **Amit Acharya, Corporate Vice President of Retail Product & Design, NCR Voyix**


The data backs this up. According to the[NCR Voyix 2025 Commerce Experience Report](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/newsroom/77-of-shoppers-choose-self-checkout-for-faster-service-according-to-new-consumer-survey-from-ncr-voyix) , 54% of consumers are enrolled in at least one fuel or convenience loyalty program, and 37% say loyalty programs are a reason they choose a specific c-store. That is an audience already primed to act, not just to look. The opportunity is to connect the impression at the pump to the loyalty profile and the register so you can turn intent into a purchase.


There's a clear disconnect between engagement at the pump and actual purchase behavior, and that's because visibility does not equal value. For CMOs, advertising shouldn't be about increasing impressions—it should be about maximizing the return on every customer interaction.


#### The limits of a "media-first" approach


Ads in your forecourt operate in a different ecosystem from your mobile engagement, loyalty systems or in-store transactions. They're not built to track the connection between a message and conversion (especially in real time). With marketing initiatives running in their own silos, there's a lost opportunity to act on high-intent customer moments.


Consider a pattern we have seen in the field. One large fuel and convenience retailer ran a season-long pump-screen campaign that logged impressions in the millions across its network, yet its in-store basket size stayed essentially flat over the same period. The screens were doing their job as a media channel. What was missing was any link between the message at the pump and the transaction at the register, so there was no way to trigger an offer, confirm a redemption or measure whether the impression moved a single shopper inside. Impressions went up. Sales did not.


Simply put, marketing without integration can't drive sustained growth.


#### Unified commerce: the foundation for connected forecourt-to-store experiences


To optimize your marketing, you need one platform. It connects your forecourt, in-store retail, foodservice and[mobile loyalty](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/platform/retail-applications/consumer-experience-loyalty-marketing) . Unified commerce means a shared data layer across all touchpoints. That gives marketers a near real-time view of what shoppers do, so they can adjust.


Unified commerce enables a single, continuous customer experience across every interaction.


##### How connected data transforms customer engagement


At NCR Voyix, we believe the future of commerce will be defined by how seamlessly businesses connect every customer interaction—across fueling, retail and dining—into a single, unified experience. When data works together, you get to offer shoppers real-time personalization. You'll be able to:


- Tailor offers at the pump based on loyalty history
- Adjust promotions in-store in near real time
- Connect past purchase behavior to current actions


Your team can turn insights into action right away. After all, your data only creates value when it's connected and actionable.


Let's make this concrete. A shopper parks the car and starts to fuel. In their loyalty app, a personalized offer for a hot dog appears. They order it and redeem some points.


In every step, each moment builds on the last. It eliminates the friction between the discovery of what's in store, the decision of what they want and the transaction time. It's a simple yet well-integrated system for your team to lead customers to a purchase without shopping around first.


Without a[unified commerce platform](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/platform) , seamless experience at scale is simply not possible.


#### Why more tools don't improve forecourt-to-store conversion


To have an efficient marketing system, it doesn't require more solutions and apps. Your business has undoubtedly invested in pump displays, mobile apps, a loyalty platform and in-store systems. Even though these capabilities all work to improve marketing, they operate independently. The industry's biggest misstep isn't a lack of tools. It's a lack of orchestration.


##### Fragmented systems create fragmented customer experiences


Each system holds separate data and logic. One of the biggest friction points for growing brands is data siloed into their software. For customers, this feels like:


- Inconsistent offers across the pump, app and register
- Repetitive interactions that ignore previous purchases
- A lack of personalization across touchpoints


Your customers don't see the channels you've built, or the MarTech you've invested in. Instead, they feel friction in your app or in the store.


##### How disconnected systems cost your business


Disconnected technology costs you. When systems aren't unified, they make things more complex and less efficient, and that trickles down to your marketing goals. Your team misses chances to convert real-time intent. Shoppers don't buy as much as they could if the experience from your forecourt ad to your app felt seamless. Inconsistent engagement means less loyalty. It starts as a tech issue. It quickly becomes a revenue issue. The reverse is also true. When the data is connected, the revenue follows. Using[Voyix Digital Commerce](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/platform/retail-applications/checkout/digital-commerce) to unify eCommerce, loyalty and transaction data, one grocery co-op grew online sales more than 500 percent and sustained double-digit growth over multiple years.


#### How NCR Voyix powers unified commerce across every touchpoint


The industry is currently at an inflection point. Many brands have disconnected tools with their technology. But now, they're optimizing through a connected ecosystem, and to be competitive, you must have one, too.


NCR Voyix is redefining the forecourt as a fully connected commerce touchpoint. The Voyix Commerce Platform unifies fuel, retail and dining into a single, continuous experience.


This is already happening at scale. In March 2026, Pilot Travel Centers signed an agreement to deploy the Voyix Commerce Platform across[more than 900 locations](https://investor.ncrvoyix.com/news-releases/news-release-details/pilot-selects-ncr-voyix-modernize-point-sale-across-its-industry) , one of the clearest signs that[unified commerce is moving from concept to standard infrastructure for fuel and convenience](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/industry/retail/convenience-fuel) .


It acts as the backbone of modern commerce. It connects transactions, customer data and engagement across every touchpoint in real time. That enables something most solutions cannot: continuous innovation without operational friction.


Retailers can't just add more marketing integrations to outpace the competition. They need a unified platform connected across every touchpoint. Platforms, not point solutions, will drive the next phase of growth. NCR Voyix is leading the shift from fragmented engagement to platform-powered unified commerce, a position validated by third-party analysts: NCR Voyix was named a Leader in the April 2025[IDC MarketScape for Retail Fuel & Convenience](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/newsroom/ncr-voyix-recognized-as-a-leader-in-idc-marketscape-report-for-retail-fuel-and-convenience) .


##### What it means to power unified commerce across shopping


When a single platform connects all your marketing touchpoints, you can operate as one. The forecourt becomes a trigger for real-time engagement and a bridge into retail and dining experiences. And without the friction that siloed data brings, you can act on intent in the moment.


#### Why seamless experiences are the new competitive standard


Nowadays, customers expect consistent interactions across every touchpoint without friction between fueling, shopping and dining. Any disconnect, whether it comes from an offer, payments or loyalty breaks trust and reduces conversions. With so much competition, customers don't tolerate fragmented experience; rather, they move on to another brand. A preferred experience is powerful enough to change where people stop: the NCR Voyix 2025 Commerce Experience Report found that 53% of consumers have gone out of their way to visit a specific gas station because they prefer its c-store.


#### Why unified commerce infrastructure drives long-term growth


The next era of growth will be defined by always-on, unified commerce infrastructure. Operating your software on a unified commerce platform gives your stores the seamless, connected experiences that keep guests coming back, improving loyalty and long-term cash flow.


> At a time when technology is moving at an unparalleled pace, we are excited to be leveraging this innovative platform to transform our point-of-sale operating environment for the future, while simplifying and modernizing our tech stack. For a network of our size, the job is to keep stores running smoothly while making meaningful improvements fast, and NCR Voyix provides another way for us to serve our guests better every day by reimagining the store experience and innovating for the future. — **Andy Lupo, Chief Technology Officer, Pilot**


#### Frequently asked questions


##### What is unified commerce for convenience and fuel retailers?


Unified commerce connects your forecourt, in-store POS, foodservice and mobile loyalty program on a single platform with a shared data layer. Instead of running separate systems for pump displays, loyalty and transactions, unified commerce gives your team near real-time visibility into shopper behavior across every touchpoint so you can personalize offers and act on high-intent moments as they happen.


##### Why doesn't forecourt signage alone drive in-store purchases?


Forecourt signage generates impressions, but impressions don't track the connection between a message at the pump and a purchase inside the store. Without integration between your pump displays, loyalty app and POS, there's no mechanism to trigger a personalized offer, confirm redemption or measure conversion. Visibility at the pump doesn't equal value at the register.


##### How does the Voyix Commerce Platform connect the forecourt to in-store transactions?


The Voyix Commerce Platform unifies fuel, retail and dining into a single continuous experience. It connects transactions, customer data and engagement across every touchpoint in real time. When a loyalty member begins fueling, the platform can trigger a personalized offer in their app, process the in-store redemption and feed that data back into the customer profile—all without manual reconciliation between separate systems.
